The first draft initiated by eng. Gaber Salah Taher, tested by eng. Osama 
Ahmed Hassanain 30 January 2006, accepted by eng. Mohamed Osama 
Soliman Salim general director, approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel Baset Rekabi Head 
Sector of Aswan Dam 1 Power Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem:

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Unit must be shut down.
Circuit breaker open and local.
Use suitable tools
Instrument secondary injection test (DHF)
Avometer, test leads
Isolate the secondary circuits of CT and PT

Look at field maintenance file and compare the setting on relay with those 
 shown on the test sheet

Open the links on terminals X111 (11,14 ) to isolate 
 the CT secondary circuit

Connect test leads between the current terminals X111 (11 - 14) terminal is 
 the common figure 1.

Open the links on terminals X111 (61,71 ) to isolate 
 the PT secondary circuit
Open the links on terminals X02 (302, 402)
Increase the current and voltage gradually until the first stage value

Record the current and voltage
 value in the test sheet.
Increase the current and voltage gradually until the second stage value

Record the current and voltage
 value in the test sheet.
Decrease the injection current and voltage gradually to zero
Close the links terminals X111 (11,14 ) , X111 (61,71)

Repeat the same last steps when you open the terminals X111 (21- 24), X111(71- 
 81)

Record the current and voltage
 value in the test sheet.
Close the links terminals X111 (21,24 ) , X111 (71,81)

Repeat the same last steps when you open the terminals X111 (31- 34), X111(61- 
 81)

Record the current and voltage
 value in the test sheet.
Close the links terminals X111 (31,34 ) , X111 (61,81)
Return back the secondary circuits of CT and PT to the normal condition

Introduction
This procedure details the testing procedures P1, to be carried 
out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Gaber Salah Taher, tested by eng. Osama

Soliman Salim general director, approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel Baset Rekabi Head
